Sloan-Swartz Centers 2012 Annual Meeting

Date: June 27–29, 2012
Location: San Diego Supercomputer Center, UC San Diego
La Jolla, California

Travel & Accommodations

Registration

Registration is by invitation only.  Out of town attendees must register by the late registration deadline, 4/30/12,  or no accommodation will be provided.   
The deadline for local attendees is 5/16/12. 

Please register online here: https://sloanswartz2012.eventbrite.com/

Housing

Once online registration (https://sloanswartz2012.eventbrite.com/) is completed, your room will be guaranteed.  Accommodations are provided by the Estancia La Jolla, Hotel & Spa for the senior members.  Pre and postdocs will stay on campus in the Marshall Apartments. 

Accommodation will be provided by the hosts for the following nights:
Wednesday, June 27th
Thursday, June 28th
Friday, June 29th

If you require accommodation outside these nights, please make arrangements.

On Campus Housing | Estancia Hotel

Travel

Travel costs will be reimbursed by your home center.
